## Work Experience & Key Impact Metrics

### 1. GoPaisa — SDE / Backend & Analytics Engineer
*Fintech & High-Throughput Data Infrastructure (2025 – Present)*
- **66× Query Latency Optimization**: Refactored the Credit Card Payment Panel backend by eliminating N+1 query bottlenecks and restructuring SQL joins, dropping query execution time from 20 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
- **High-Concurrency Streaming Export**: Architected an in-memory streaming export pipeline capable of streaming 1.5M+ financial records in under 15 seconds without memory spikes, protected with global concurrency locking to prevent database starvation.
- **Self-Serve Analytics Dashboard**: Built analytics and campaign performance infrastructure aggregating data across 92 active marketing campaigns and processing 228K+ clicks in real time.

### 2. IncNut Digital — AI Intern (LLM Application Developer)
*Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems (Jul 2025 – Oct 2025)*
- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Built production autonomous multi-agent LLM systems with LangGraph and Flowise for flagship D2C wellness brands Vedix and SkinKraft.
- **60% Customer Support Automation**: Automated routine user queries and support ticket resolution using multi-agent intent routing and tool execution.
- **35.7% Churn Reduction**: Refined LLM state transitions and prompt logic, eliminating order cancellation blockers for 35.7% of users.

### 3. TableSprint — Full Stack Engineering Trainee

### 1. PM2 Auto Recovery Alerts (DevOps & Self-Healing Infra)
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, MongoDB, SSH, Docker, REST API, Webhooks
- **Description**: A self-hosted infrastructure daemon that continuously monitors remote virtual machines, detects crashed or degraded PM2 Node.js processes, triggers automated SSH self-healing restarts, and dispatches rich alert payloads across Slack, Flock, and Telegram.

### 2. AI Compare (Real-Time LLM Benchmarking)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Google Gemini API, DeepSeek API, Web Streams

- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shubhanshu-ism/AI-Compare
- **Live Demo**: https://ai-compare-steel.vercel.app/
